summary: A working wholesale flower district near Memorial Bridge, best approached as a short observational walk. Flowers, garlands and delivery activity make this a distinctive alternative to souvenir shopping; allow vendors room to work.
whyGo: See fresh flowers in bulk and the handwork behind traditional garlands.
Experience an everyday commercial neighbourhood after the main temple sights close.
bestFor: Photographers, flower enthusiasts and early risers.
A low-cost Old City stop paired with the riverfront.
skipIf: You need an air-conditioned attraction or guaranteed comfortable seating.
You dislike crowded working aisles, wet surfaces or delivery carts.
duration: Allow 45–90 minutes for a self-guided wander; this is a planning estimate, with longer possible for photography or refreshments.
cost: Entry is free. Flowers, snacks and transport are extra; no fixed visitor spending budget or December 2026 stall prices are verified.
hours: Market district operates daily around the clock; individual stalls keep their own hours. A 24-hour market does not mean every vendor is always open.
bestTime: For the freshest displays and active trading, the government visitor guide recommends 05:00–08:00. Late evening offers atmosphere; deliveries continue after midnight.
gettingThere: MRT Blue Line to Sanam Chai, then roughly 400 metres from Exit 4 or 5 to Chak Phet Road. For an overnight visit, check rail operating times and plan a taxi return rather than assuming trains run all night.
booking: No admission reservation is needed for an independent market walk. Optional guided tours are a separate purchase and were not assessed.
accessibility: No reliable step-free route through the market or accessible toilet information was verified. Delivery congestion and slippery floors may make navigation difficult; wheelchair users should confirm a suitable route locally.
practicalTips: Bring small cash, water and a reusable bag; wear shoes with grip.
Ask before photographing people or close-up work, and avoid blocking sales or carts.
Keep the visit flexible: select a quieter aisle if unloading is intense.
decemberNotes: Treat this as a year-round market visit for December 2026. No special December programme or holiday stall schedule was verified; confirm transport near your chosen date.
uncertainties: Exact individual stall hours, current purchase prices and accessible facilities remain unverified.
The photograph dates from 2010 and is a historical reference, not proof of the current layout.
